family: regularized correction to each deployed model using opponent-adjusted historical goal and xG attack/defence
selectionRule: Fit all coefficients and score-grid corrections on training only; select the converged candidate with the best selection log loss among candidates passing every selection metric. Freeze one winner before later audits; do not search later splits for another winner.

acceptance.logLoss: strictly better than deployed competition model

leakageControls: exclude target fixture and all same-UTC-day results
build opponent features using only data prior to each historical match
verify provider team IDs, fixture dates, scores and neutral venues
interpretation: Domestic 2023-2026 outcomes were inspected in earlier development; these are regression audits, not pristine independent validation. Newly collected cup history is evaluated only after freezing the selection. Historical improvements are not guarantees of future accuracy.
fallback: Retain the deployed model whenever the new league gate, identity, coverage or freshness check fails. Do not manufacture xG or alter a team's probability to match rankings or a desired result.
